decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-e3ced89ceb9e] says the change is in tests: the test code now calls t.Fatal instead of os.Exit (part 2 of #21003). That gives the subject (the project's test code), the change (how test failures are handled, from os.Exit to t.Fatal) and, from its scope, the applicability: it names nothing that ships or that operators configure, so no environment condition applies. An engineer could therefore write this as an informational, no-consequence assertion without needing more sources.
